# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Retail Trade | Multi-Sector: Grocery retailer plus two divisions

| | |
|---|---|
| Scope at this tier | Each division's primary regulation plus group-wide obligations |
| Expected depth | Regulation-by-division matrix |
| Deliverable form | Gap tables per division plus group roadmap |
| Universal method | [step-05_P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/README.md](../../../../00_universal-framework/projects/step-05_P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/README.md) |
| Scenario brief | [README.md](../README.md) |

**Regulation to analyze:** PCI DSS v4.0.1, PCI DSS v4.0.1 (PCI SSC, June 2024)
**Why:** Nearly every retailer accepts cards, PCI DSS is the only prescriptive, testable control standard universally imposed on retail (via acquirer contracts), and its 12 requirements map cleanly to a gap assessment. It is not law; supplement with FTC Safeguards Rule for retailers issuing credit or auto dealers, and CCPA cyber-audit regs for large California-facing retailers.
